title: Auxin-Inducible Depletion of PTBP1 in Mouse Embryonic Stem Cells
author: Kainov, Zhuravskaya, et al.

steps.title: Prepare feeder‑free ESC culture media
steps.instruction: Prepare the media required for feeder‑free mouse embryonic stem cell (ESC) culture as described in the methods (exact composition not detailed in the text).

steps.title: Propagate parental A2lox ESC line
steps.instruction: Maintain and expand the parental mouse ESC line A2lox under standard ESC culture conditions.

steps.title: Introduce doxycycline‑inducible OsTIR1
steps.instruction: Perform Cre/Lox recombination‑mediated monoallelic knock‑in of the TRE‑OsTIR1 transgene into the A2lox ESC line to generate TRE‑OsTIR1 ESCs.

steps.title: Co‑transfect TRE‑OsTIR1 ESCs
steps.instruction: Co‑transfect TRE‑OsTIR1 ESCs with (i) a Ptbp1‑specific CRISPR‑Cas9 plasmid and (ii) two homology‑directed repair (HDR) constructs encoding the mini‑AID (mAID) cassette and the HygR and BSD selection markers (Addgene #206997 and #206998; PuroR #206999 is optional). The HDR constructs contain left (Ptbp1 HAL) and right (Ptbp1 HAR) homology arms flanking the mAID sequence.

steps.title: Select antibiotic‑resistant colonies
steps.instruction: Apply hygromycin B and blasticidin S selection to the transfected cells (concentrations not specified). Identify and pick undifferentiated colonies that are resistant to both antibiotics; avoid differentiated colonies.

steps.title: Genotype candidate clones
steps.instruction: Perform PCR genotyping on hygromycin‑ and blasticidin‑resistant clones using the primer sets listed in Table 1. Expected PCR product sizes are: 775 bp (mAID‑specific) and 1507 bp (wild‑type) for the primary screen; additional primer pairs give 385 bp, 1507 bp (wild‑type) vs. 3237 bp (mAID knock‑in, not detectable under standard conditions), 775 bp, 1298 bp, and 1325 bp.

steps.title: Identify biallelic mAID knock‑in clones
steps.instruction: Select clones that produce the mAID‑specific PCR product but not the wild‑type product for both alleles (e.g., clones 13 and 21), indicating successful biallelic tagging of Ptbp1 with mAID.

steps.title: Induce OsTIR1 and PTBP1 degradation
steps.instruction: Treat validated Ptbp1‑mAID clones with doxycycline (concentration not specified) and indole‑3‑acetic acid (IAA, auxin) for 24 h to induce expression of OsTIR1 and degradation of mAID‑tagged PTBP1.

steps.title: Validate depletion by RT‑qPCR and immunoblot
steps.instruction: Assess OsTIR1 expression and PTBP1‑mAID depletion using RT‑qPCR and immunoblotting. Note that PTBP1‑mAID migrates at 64.7 kDa, whereas wild‑type PTBP1 migrates at 56.9 kDa.
